subject: Doctor with stethoscope
parts: a stick figure bust with a small detached hollow circle head at the top, one broad rounded shoulder arc below it open at the bottom, and a separate large stethoscope entirely inside the shoulder arc with a U-shaped tube and a curved tail ending in a hollow circle at the right; leave a full stroke width of white space between the head and shoulder arc and between every part of the stethoscope and the shoulder arc
